name: gcp-auth
description: Mints short-lived access tokens for a Google Cloud service account on the host, with your own Google login (`gcloud auth application-default login`), and hands the container only those: gcloud and the Google client libraries use them as if running on GCE.

settings.label: Service account
settings.description: The gcp-service-account the sandbox acts as. Your application default credentials (or its credentialFile) needs roles/iam.serviceAccountTokenCreator on it.
